name: ranger_grapple_swing_rnd
description: Ranger grapple swing: throw hook at P3 underside from floor, swing on rope, jump-release with momentum.
script: # Spawn ranger on floor below P3 (upper-left platform at 669,525)
announce Grapple swing: throw at P3, swing, jump-release
# Step 1: Wind up grapple aimed at P3 underside
# From (669,876) toward P3 edge (700,525): mostly straight up → (0.09, -0.99)
# Step 2: Hook should now be attached. Let pendulum swing develop.
# Push right during swing to build momentum
# Step 3: Jump to release rope with swing momentum
# Step 4: Let physics settle — ranger should fly and land
notify {SCRIPT} "Did ranger swing and launch?" ["YES","NO"] {inspect} blocking
